description: The Food and Agriculture Organization publishes an archived CSV from the FAOSTAT Energy Use domain. It contains agricultural energy activity, emission factors and greenhouse-gas emissions for fossil fuels and electricity. Fuel categories include gas-diesel oil, coal, natural gas including LNG, motor gasoline, fuel oil and liquefied petroleum gas. Fossil-fuel activity originates from UNSD and IEA statistics. Zenodo provides the normalised table publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. The repository summary does not state the exact country coverage, observation years or aggregation interval, so these must be checked in the table before numerical use. That limitation prevents treating the deposit as a current global demand series. It can support agricultural energy-demand and emissions scenarios once its dimensions are checked. The dataset complements the catalogue’s FAOSTAT agrifood emissions shares with the separately published energy-use component. No CSV was downloaded.
